Configure liter-llm to extract text with a vision-capable model

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput
from xberg._xberg import ExtractionConfig

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput.from_json("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"image/png\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png\"}")
    config = ExtractionConfig.from_json("{\"force_ocr\":true,\"ocr\":{\"backend\":\"vlm\",\"enabled\":true,\"language\":[\"eng\"],\"vlm_config\":{\"model\":\"openai/gpt-4o-mini\",\"temperature\":0.0}}}")
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
